diagrams.name: System Architecture
diagrams.description: End to end: one dongle arbitrated between voice, digital decoders and IQ collection, across a UI/radio process split
diagrams.mermaid:
graph TD SDR[RTL-SDR Blog V4] -->|USB| ARB[SDR Arbiter
queue-of-one, LOCKED/SWITCHING/FAULT] STREAM[Web streams] -->|HTTP| FF[ffmpeg] ARB --> TUNE[rtl_fm / iq_capture] ARB --> DEC[Digital decoders] ARB --> COLL[IQ collector] TUNE -->|16k PCM| SRC[InputSource] FF -->|16k PCM| SRC SRC --> VAD[Adaptive VAD
gates on level above noise floor] VAD --> WH[Whisper
Hailo-8L, CPU fallback] SRC --> AUD[Audio Router] DEC --> D1[ADS-B / ACARS / APRS / AIS] DEC --> D2[ISM rtl_433 / POCSAG pager] DEC --> D3[NOAA APT / WEFAX / meteor] SRC --> SEG[IQ Segmenter] --> CLF[Signal Classifier
MobileNetV2 spectrograms] SEG --> SEI[SEI fingerprinting] COLL --> CORPUS[(Labelled corpus
labels from tuned preset)] WH --> RADIO AUD --> RADIO D1 --> RADIO D2 --> RADIO D3 --> RADIO CLF --> RADIO SEI --> RADIO RADIO[radio process
owns all hardware] -->|NDJSON over Unix socket| UI[ui process
Flask + Socket.IO] UI -->|WebSocket + HTTP| BROWSER[Console: 6 tabbed views]

diagrams.name: Input Mode Selection

    A[Startup] --> B{rtl_test -t}
    B -->|exit 0| C[SDR Mode]
    B -->|exit != 0| D[Web Stream Mode]
    C --> E[Tuner - rtl_fm]
    D --> F[StreamSource - ffmpeg]
    E --> G[InputSource PCM Queue]
    F --> G

diagrams.name: Thread Model
diagrams.description: Where green threads and real threads meet, and the rule that keeps them apart
diagrams.mermaid:
graph LR subgraph green[UI process — eventlet green threads] SIO[Socket.IO handlers] HTTP[Flask routes] DRAIN[emit drain loop] end subgraph real[Radio process — real OS threads] TUN[tuner reader] DECT[decoder readers] INF[inference workers] SCHED[schedulers] end TUN --> BR[ThreadSafeEmitter
real queue] DECT --> BR INF --> BR SCHED --> BR BR --> DRAIN --> SIO RULE[Real threads must never touch
green logging locks or socketio.emit —
eventlet makes those locks green and
a real thread raises greenlet.error] BR -.- RULE

single owner of the dongle] HW[tuner, decoders, Hailo, IQ collection] end IS --> AR --> HW X[Radio process dies or restarts] -.->|console stays up,
